question: Which Indian dancer achieved recognition in Guinness World Records 2023 by completing a five-day dance marathon?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Srushti Sudhir Jagtap**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Srushti Sudhir Jagtap**, an Indian dancer, achieved worldwide recognition by completing a **five-day dance marathon**, earning her a spot in the **Guinness World Records 2023.**
 
• This remarkable feat required immense **endurance**, **, and passion** for dance.
 
• The achievement highlights India's rich **cultural heritage** and the significance of dance as an integral part of Indian tradition.
 
• Dance marathons are challenging events where participants need to sustain their energy and rhythm for an extended period, showcasing their **physical and mental strength**.
 
• **Srushti Sudhir Jagtap** has become an inspiration for aspiring dancers and performers across the globe.
 
• The recognition in the **Guinness World Records** adds to India's legacy of producing exceptional talents who excel on an international stage.
